Team —

Quick kickoff for this week: our mid-quarter forecast needs a short, surgical cleanup so numbers are submission-ready on Friday. I attached the raw pipeline export from HubSpot for the Zephyr account (pipeline_export_Q2.csv) — please use it as the source of truth for stage updates.

Top asks (priority order):
- Everyone owning deals in the Zephyr book: update Stage + Expected Close Date + Probability in HubSpot by EOD Wednesday (May 12).
- Mark any deals with open legal/procurement blockers in the Deal Notes field with the word "PROC-OPEN" so RevOps can filter.
- If you change a stage to Commit/Commit-Pending, add a one-line rationale in the CRM (e.g., "pricing approved 5/10; PO expected 5/20").
- Send me a 1-line call goal if you want me to lead the Friday commit call.

Call logistics: I'll run a focused 25-minute sync on Friday 11:00–11:25 PT to surface at-risk line items and land any committable deals. Draft agenda attached (Agenda_v2.pdf). If you need a different time, flag it here.

Attachments: pipeline_export_Q2.csv (CSV), Agenda_v2.pdf (PDF)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-8342
Calendar invite to follow once we confirm time: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Thanks — small but high-impact cleanup this week.
